recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant 1990s-style layout featuring a central photographic subject—a custom vintage car and a model—framed by bold, saturated vertical color bars and heavy, chrome-textured display typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical sidebars framing a central square photographic field
Arched chrome header text interacting with the sky background
High-contrast lighting on the car's metallic finish and the model
Complementary color scheme between the green car and red/green sidebars
coreInvariants: Arched 'rainbow' path for the primary title
Hard-edged drop shadows on all graphic elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Model and car centered horizontally, occupying the lower two-thirds of the central frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, arched chrome title at the top center acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the arched header, move down to the model/car, then scan the vertical text on the left and right borders.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Clear blue sky in the upper center provides breathing room for the complex typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Sky blue and mint green (central image)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright red and forest green (side borders)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Gold/Chrome (typography) and White (text and car roof)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all primary colors with high-value highlights on metallic surfaces.

letterConstructionRules: Primary title: Arched path, heavy block letters with a 'horizon' chrome gradient (brown to gold).
Secondary title: Fluid, slanted brush script with high contrast.
Border text: Vertical orientation, extra-bold geometric sans-serif with wide tracking.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the main title are tapered toward the bottom to fit the arch.
Vertical text is rotated 90 degrees or stacked depending on the specific border.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy industrial block letters paired with organic, fast-moving script.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight for the vertical border text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-resolution photo of a mint-green 1960s lowrider car parked on sand, with a model in a blue swimsuit standing next to it. The background features a clear blue sky and brown rocky hills. Add a thick green vertical bar on the left and a thick red vertical bar on the right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large arched chrome-textured title at the top center with a black drop shadow. Place a black script subtitle immediately below it. Add white bold vertical text inside the green and red sidebars.

verificationChecks: Is the main title arched and chrome-textured?
Are there distinct red and green vertical borders?
Is the car's metallic finish highly reflective?
Is the script text slanted and black?

adjustableVariables: Chrome gradient colors (e.g., silver vs gold)
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the chrome text has a distinct 'horizon line' reflection.
Check that vertical text is perfectly aligned within the sidebars.
Verify the car's shadow on the sand looks natural despite the graphic overlays.
Confirm the arch of the top text is symmetrical.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central automotive photography + Arched chrome display type + Vertical color-block borders with bold sans-serif text.
